programmes.d: The unwelcome appearance in Eastbridge of white supremacists leads to a murder, with the suspicion soon arising that one or more of Tony's associates may be implicated.
A husband wants vengeance after Stan kills his armed wife during their domestic dispute. Meanwhile, cops buff up for modeling auditions.
After Susan is arrested for Mel's murder, Vinnie refuses McPike's order to pull out of the Profitt case — because Susan has told him she is pregnant with his child.
Vinnie demands to stay on the case to get to the bottom of Roger Lococco's ties to a rogue CIA operation.
Roger signs his own death warrant by testifying to a Senate committee about a cabal within the U.S. intelligence community, but he needs Vinnie to back him up.
Hunter travels to Australia to help solve a murder case involving a former girlfriend who has been missing for three years.
Hunter's vacation is shattered when he falls in love with a beautiful professional killer who's connected to an arson scheme he's investigating.
McCall lands in hot water when she reopens the case her husband was working on when he was killed.
